deployments_detail.use: AI voice bot for customer contact center handling insurance consultations, renewal contract management, premium payments, and account registration/changes [in-house (ML-based NLP)]

Joint R&D with KT to build an insurance-specialized AI model (using KT's Mi:dm K 2.0 LLM) plus automated claims/medical-document recognition, trained on Meritz's insurance data, policy terms and business documents [KT (Mi:dm K 2.0)]

Agentic AI system for natural-language stock screening and financial Q&A built with the AWS GenAI Innovation Center over an 8-week engagement, using Amazon Bedrock, OpenSearch and Aurora, with built-in compliance guardrails; designed and validated, targeted for launch H1 2026 [AWS (Amazon Bedrock, OpenSearch, Aurora)]

Strategic partnership with WNSTN to integrate infrastructure-grade multi-agent AI (with compliance controls) into Meritz Securities' next-generation digital investment platform for real-time client inquiries and investment assistance; launch planned early 2026 [WNSTN]

Partnership with US social-investing platform Stocktwits to build an AI-driven next-generation stock investment platform, integrating community and AI-based trend analysis plus AI translation for global (overseas-stock) investors [Stocktwits]
Co-development with global fintech Webull of an AI-based next-generation global investment platform ('Moeum') leveraging Webull's 14-country network and AI technology [Webull]

Company-wide ChatGPT / generative-AI literacy training (prompt engineering, data analysis, coding, project management) for employees, plus a dedicated in-house employee-work-support AI designated an FSC innovative financial service [OpenAI (ChatGPT)]

AI-based insurance fraud detection via the Special Investigation Unit (SIU), flagging anomalies at claims submission, tip-line reports, and analysis of already-paid claims data (e.g., detecting AI-forged medical records) [none]

Adoption of Palantir AI for insurance fraud detection (excessive/false claims) and internal management diagnostics; PoC technical verification completed with plans to sign a contract by year-end [Palantir]

Generative-AI insurance counseling assistant that analyzes a customer's insurance data to recommend suitable products and generate consultation scripts for sales agents; approved as an FSC innovative financial service (regulatory sandbox), billed as first among Korean non-life insurers to use generative AI in counseling [Microsoft Azure OpenAI]

Inswave WebSquare AI, an AI-agent-based low-code development platform (with W-Craft auto-conversion) used to build and standardize Meritz Fire's next-generation UI/screens, cutting development effort and cost; Phase 1 delivered, Phase 2 underway [Inswave Systems (WebSquare AI)]
